Team —

Attached is a first-pass heatmap for the engineering & platform verticals (see "20261118-calibration-heatmap-v2.xlsx"). I pushed in raw ratings, normalized buckets, and the cross-team anchors we've discussed. Purpose of this thread: align on two things before the calibration session next Monday (11/22):

1) Which anchors we will use for inter-team comparisons (I highlighted 6 potential anchors in the sheet).
2) Any outliers we want to pre-surface to HR so they can bring context (promotions, extended leaves, partial-year managers).

Quick asks:
- Please review the heatmap and mark any anchor rows you believe are inappropriate for cross-team comparison.
- Flag any folks you know have extenuating context — I want HR to have a short list before we open the floor.
- If you have proposed redistribution suggestions, send them to me privately; we'll decide whether to surface in the session.

Confidentiality note: this material is internal and sensitive. Do not forward outside the participant list.

Proposed agenda (45 minutes): 10m framing + calibrators, 25m anchors & problem cases, 10m decisions and next steps.

Thanks — I know this is tight timeline but calibrating on a small number of anchors will make the session far more efficient.

— Maya
